rules_evaluated.evidence: Raw L136-143: all 7 backing-block sources carry `due:none`, replacing the file's PRIOR `due:cohort` on the exact same 7 URLs (confirmed via the b3143a4..HEAD diff — this is a genuine value change introduced by this diff, not pre-existing). §2a requires, ALL THREE: first-hand ✓, 'a specific completed event (not a practice, trend or rate)' ✗, 'dated in body' ✗. Of the 7: martin-two-windows describes an ONGOING WORKFLOW ('I'm keeping two Claude windows open...') — explicitly the excluded 'practice' shape, undated in body (body L9 says only 'He experiments with running separate Claude sessions', no month/year). martin-six-fundamentals, martin-manage-structure, martin-juniors, martin-dijkstra are Martin's general STANCES on testing/architecture/mentoring/formalism — squarely 'who-currently-believes-what,' which §2a explicitly lists as STILL ON THE CLOCK regardless of first-hand report. Only martin-ais-are-faster and martin-visualization are arguably closer to episodic ('I had the AI write a visualization tool... I found it useful'), and even those are undated in body. The compendium's own canonical spec for this exact block type (`curriculum/backing-format.md` § Sources, 'Foundational-literature variant') reinforces this independently: it reserves `due:none` for canonical PUBLISHED WORKS (Saltzer, Ashby) and states explicitly 'Freshness applies to what moves: deployment numbers, adoption rates, platform capability, **who-currently-thinks-what**. Not to what was published once and stayed published' — Martin's tweets about his current testing philosophy are exactly the excluded category under the file's own governing spec, not just under check_research_claims.md. HARM: the compendium's own worked failure (§2b, Amp's handoff reversal) shows this exact shape going wrong for three months while the stamp stayed 'audit-clean' precisely because due:none never re-opens; this file's own backing Stance block already names the falsifier ('would-move-it: Martin publishing a position that contradicts the steering framing') but the per-source freshness mechanism (source-freshness.sh, which drives pre-cohort re-verification) will never surface that shift because due:none is permanently skipped by the script — only the separate, unscripted 'OODA last-run' narrative field would catch it, and nothing enforces that field's re-run. The fix (due:cohort, matching what these 7 lines carried before this diff) is low-risk and does not degrade the artefact.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Restore `due:cohort` (the value these 7 lines carried before this diff) on the 6 sources that are stances/practices rather than dated completed events; reserve `due:none` only for a genuinely episodic, body-dated report if one exists.
